text: Remote Work Policy (v2). Applies to all full-time employees of Kestrel Data Labs (fictional company). Employees may work remotely for a maximum of 3 days per week; the remaining days must be worked from the assigned office. Fully remote arrangements require written approval from the department head and the Chief People Officer. Core collaboration hours are 11:00 to 16:00 IST. Working from outside India is limited to 30 days per calendar year and needs prior approval from HR and Security. A one-time home office allowance of INR 15,000 is available in the first 6 months of joining.

Leave Policy (v3). Full-time employees receive 24 days of annual leave per calendar year, accruing at 2 days per completed month of service. Up to 10 unused annual leave days can be carried over to the next year; any balance above 10 days lapses on 31 December. Planned leave must be applied for at least 7 calendar days in advance. Employees receive 12 days of paid sick leave per year, which cannot be carried over. A medical certificate is required for sick leave longer than 2 consecutive days.

Travel and Expense Policy (v4). Economy class is standard for flights of up to 6 hours; employees at level L5 and above may book business class for longer flights. The meals cap is INR 2,500 per day for domestic travel and USD 75 per day for international travel. Itemised receipts are required for any expense above INR 500. Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of returning; claims older than 60 days are not reimbursed. Hotels are capped at INR 7,000 per night in metro cities.

Information Security Policy (v1). Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is mandatory for email, VPN and all cloud tools. Passwords must be at least 14 characters long and must never be shared. The company VPN must be used on any network other than the office network or a trusted home network. Suspected security incidents, such as a clicked phishing link or a lost laptop, must be reported within 1 hour to security@kestrel.example. Personal USB storage devices are blocked on company laptops.

Code of Conduct (v2). Employees may accept gifts from business partners only if the value is INR 3,000 or less and the gift is not cash. Gifts above INR 3,000 must be declined or declared to Compliance within 7 days. Conflicts of interest, including second jobs, must be disclosed to the manager and Compliance. Harassment complaints should be made to the Internal Committee within 3 months of the incident.

Learning and Development Policy (v1). Every permanent employee has an annual learning budget of INR 50,000 per financial year; unused budget does not roll over. Certification exam fees are reimbursed in full on passing. If an employee resigns within 12 months of a reimbursed learning expense above INR 25,000, 100% of that amount is recovered from the final settlement.

Performance and Promotion Policy (v2). Performance reviews happen twice a year, in April and October, on a 5-point scale. To be eligible for promotion, an employee needs at least 18 months in the current level and a rating of 4 or higher in each of the last two review cycles. An employee rated 1 is placed on a 60-day Performance Improvement Plan.
